title: Run an Ionic/Cordova CLI command scoped to the invoking project's own root
description: Runs a Cordova or Ionic CLI command from the invoking project's root, through Node.

cli.description: Which CLI to run, resolved from the workspace root and run through Node, never through node_modules/.bin.

command.description: The CLI subcommand to run, e.g. 'build', 'platform', 'prepare'.

args.description: Extra arguments appended after the command.

plugin.description: A Cordova plugin spec (npm package name, git URL, or local path), appended right after the extra arguments and before the platform. Meant for the plugin-add and plugin-rm configurations, e.g. --plugin=cordova-plugin-x.

platform.description: An optional platform name (e.g. 'android', 'ios'), appended after the command.

deploy.description: Where 'run' deploys the app: 'device' appends --device, 'emulator' appends --emulator, last in the argument vector. Unset appends neither. Pass --deploy=emulator on the command line to override a configuration's value.
